text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While out shopping, I ran into Mr. C.B. on a stroll.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey there. Out for a walk too... or wait, running errands? What a coincidence.
choice_data_list: Yeah... Wait, oh. Come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ? What's up, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I suddenly remembered that before I left to go shopping, a teacher at the Academy was searching for Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They were calling her name loudly over and over, which had caught my attention.
choice_data_list: They said some important document hadn't been submitted.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Thanks for letting me know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though it concerned her directly, Mr. C.B. replied as if it were someone else's business entirely.
choice_data_list: Don't you need to head back?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I was actually planning on heading to a cafe right now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: So, I don't really plan on going back. I'm thirsty anyway, so it can't be helped, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Besides, that cafe has a cactus-flavored drink on the menu.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Not that I have any special attachment to cacti or anything, but the second I saw it, I got super curious.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because Ace told me the other day, "Looking at C.B.'s racing outfit reminds me of a cactus." Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though it could be an important document related to her races, Mr. C.B. remained completely unfazed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fully aware that it was none of my business, I instinctively followed along to try and persuade her, but Mr. C.B. didn't seem concerned in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah, it wasn't cactus-flavored after all, just shaped like a cactus container.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, since I came all this way, I might as well buy one and take it back.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: What about you?
choice_data_list: Oh, I'll have the same... Wait, no, that's not why I'm here!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh. This container is solid green, kind of reminds me of Rudolf. Maybe I'll get it as a souvenir.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Despite my attempts to persuade her, she didn't seem to be listening at all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: We've walked quite a bit... I didn't expect you to follow me all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You never gave up trying to convince me... Is going all out for others just part of a Trainer's nature?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Even though you must've known it wouldn't work no matter what you said.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Nice. I don't dislike that way of thinking at all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Being tied down or clinging to things... I don't really have any connection to that stuff, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I know plenty of girls who never give up. None of them know what boredom even feels like.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Watching them gets me all excited.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It sounded somewhat philosophical, as if she were standing on the outside looking in, distinct from "everyone else."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It might have been an uncalled-for and presumptuous thought, but I couldn't help feeling that way. Free, uncatchable, and distant.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You're quite the softie, aren't you? But following my feelings is just who I am. I can't be like everyone else.
choice_data_list: What if, say, you went against your feelings...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: What would happen, you ask? ...Well, I wouldn't know. What do you think?
choice_data_list: Maybe you'd discover a new side of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Surprisingly enough, maybe nothing would change at all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Or hey, maybe I'd make some brand-new discoveries?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In a tone that was neither entirely joking nor entirely serious, a small smile graced Mr. C.B.'s lips.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, no matter what path I walk, I think I'll always be me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her words, forever elusive, held an undeniable charm. Convinced that this was simply who Mr. C.B. was, I nodded in understanding.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha, now that's pretty wild.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's test it out. I'll go against my current mood and go find out what those important documents are.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, because I'm kind of curious about this "new side of me"—... Wait.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Now that I'm in the mood to go back, I'm not going against my feelings at all, am I? Guess I won't be meeting any new self after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sounding disappointed, yet not deeply concerned in the slightest, Mr. C.B. let out a laugh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You're right. I can't even begin to imagine myself like that.
choice_data_list: Sorry for tagging along just to lecture you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No need to apologize. If I really didn't want you around, I could've ditched you anytime.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Walking with you while you made that desperate face just wasn't a bad mood to be in, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. gave a mischievous grin. Realizing I stood no chance against this girl, I couldn't help but smile wryly.
